evidenceLevel: Source inventory. Static render mapping is best effort; dynamic renderers and redirects need review.

tour.title: Create your account
tour.blurb: A name and a way back in. Nothing here is asked to prove you deserve a vote — living somewhere is the whole test.

tour.title: The four doors
tour.blurb: The whole world, four ways in: be a resident, watch a government work, run an organization, or run a node.

tour.title: Home
tour.blurb: What’s happening now, and what’s yours to act on.

tour.title: My record
tour.blurb: Your civic life in one place — residency, votes cast (never how), and your public acts.

tour.title: Journeys
tour.blurb: Learn by doing — each journey walks one real process; finishing one goes on your profile.

tour.title: Learn
tour.blurb: Plain-language explanations of how any of this works. Reading costs nothing and unlocks nothing — knowing is not a qualification.

tour.title: Say where you live
tour.blurb: Living in a place is the only requirement for every right here.

tour.title: Places
tour.blurb: Every place on Earth, planet to neighborhood — each governs itself.

tour.title: Legislatures
tour.blurb: Every chamber, sized by population — seats follow people.

tour.title: The public square
tour.blurb: Open speech on the public record — no one can quietly remove it.

tour.title: Messages
tour.blurb: Direct and group messages — private, like a ballot.

tour.title: Petitions
tour.blurb: Gather signatures to put a question to everyone.

tour.title: The halls
tour.blurb: Where a place talks to itself — threads bound to the bills, candidacies and petitions actually in front of it.

tour.title: A place’s commons — the square
tour.blurb: The square scoped to one jurisdiction: the same open record, only about here.

tour.title: A place’s commons — the halls
tour.blurb: Testimony that can be sealed into the permanent record — speech that becomes evidence.

tour.title: An election
tour.blurb: The race, its phase, and the clock.

tour.title: Open ballot
tour.blurb: The approval phase — quietly approve the people you’d want on the ballot.

tour.title: Ranked ballot
tour.blurb: Rank your choices — seats go out in fair shares, and no vote is wasted.

tour.title: Results
tour.blurb: The count, round by round — watch votes move until every seat is filled.

tour.title: Stand for office
tour.blurb: If you live there, you can run — that’s the whole requirement.

tour.title: Organizations
tour.blurb: Parties, businesses, nonprofits — one open registry, no party machinery.

tour.title: The docket
tour.blurb: Every case is public record — panels of judges, juries of residents.

tour.title: Public records
tour.blurb: The permanent public record — it cannot be quietly edited.

tour.title: The audit chain
tour.blurb: Every act, hash-chained — verify it yourself.

tour.title: Amendments
tour.blurb: The constitution changes through exactly two doors — both in the open.

tour.title: The clocks
tour.blurb: Every interval, deadline, and threshold that starts a process without anyone asking.

tour.title: Report an issue
tour.blurb: A bug, a question, or something that needs review — file it here.

tour.title: How a place wakes up
tour.blurb: The critical-population threshold and the seven-step activation that brings a place to life.

tour.title: Union formation
tour.blurb: How places join into one — by dual supermajority, with join and exit mirrored.

tour.title: Removing a middle layer
tour.blurb: Constituents fold up one level and keep governing themselves.

tour.title: Rebuilding a lost government
tour.blurb: The restoration cascade, legitimacy scoring, and the defense of a place brought back.

tour.title: Between governments
tour.blurb: Federation, borders settled by supermajority, and how instances stay one world.

tour.title: The civic stipend
tour.blurb: A modest, unconditional share for taking part — paid to people, never to accounts.

tour.title: Agreements
tour.blurb: Every contract has a floor of terms — open one to see its signatures and the deal.

tour.title: Achievements
tour.blurb: Civic firsts, guided journeys, and a place’s milestones, sealed to an append-only record.

tour.title: The market
tour.blurb: Your money, the open market, and public finance — the whole economy in one place.

tour.title: My wallet
tour.blurb: What you hold and what has moved — private to you, like a ballot.

tour.title: The open market
tour.blurb: Offers and requests between people — a two-sided market, settled in the open.

tour.title: Units & money
tour.blurb: What a unit is and how money is issued — abstract, with no payment rails.

tour.title: Public finance
tour.blurb: A place’s treasury, in the open — what came in, what went out, and why.

tour.title: Joint ledgers
tour.blurb: Shared accounts that move only when the people who share them agree.

tour.title: Worker seats on the board
tour.blurb: Past a threshold of employees, workers elect seats on the board — by the same fair count.

tour.title: Ownership changes
tour.blurb: How an organization changes hands or converts type — every step on the record.

tour.title: Move somewhere new
tour.blurb: Change where you live and your rights follow you — residency is the only key.

tour.title: Terms end together
tour.blurb: Why civil and judicial terms move in lockstep — ten years, synchronized.

tour.title: Reach
tour.blurb: How many have taken part — a gauge that measures, never a lever that rules.

tour.title: Your reports
tour.blurb: Everything you’ve filed and where it went — a bug, a question, or a call for review.

tour.title: Accessibility
tour.blurb: What’s built in, what’s still coming, and how to tell us where it falls short.

tour.title: The hard questions
tour.blurb: The design decisions people ask about most, answered against the Template.

tour.title: The operator plane
tour.blurb: The volunteer servers the world runs on — keeping one online buys no vote and no seat.

tour.title: DNS & certificates
tour.blurb: How a node is reached on the network, and how it proves it’s really itself.

tour.title: Moderation & the legal floor
tour.blurb: The only removals allowed — four narrow carve-outs, never a viewpoint.

tour.title: The node console
tour.blurb: One node’s own health and state. Everything here is a gauge, never a lever over anybody’s rights.

tour.title: Who runs this node
tour.blurb: The people trusted with the machine — a separate question from who holds office, and it confers none.

tour.title: The mesh
tour.blurb: Which other instances this one has met, and what it accepts from them.

tour.title: Identity & keys
tour.blurb: How this node proves it is itself, and how it recognises its neighbours.

tour.title: Versions & upgrades
tour.blurb: What code this node is running — one world can span versions, so it has to be legible.

tour.title: Day-to-day operations
tour.blurb: Backups, queues and the jobs that keep the clocks turning.

tour.title: Federation console
tour.blurb: Peering, Full Faith & Credit, and which instance is authoritative for what.

tour.title: A live committee hearing
tour.blurb: A committee meets in the open — anyone may watch, residents may testify, and every word goes on the permanent record. The chair runs the room; the system runs the bureaucracy.
